args: root="${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; if [ -z "$root" ]; then for candidate in "$PWD/plugins/brain" "$HOME/.codex/.tmp/marketplaces/red-skills/plugins/brain" "$HOME/.codex/plugins/cache/red-skills/brain"/*; do if [ -f "$candidate/.claude-plugin/plugin.json" ]; then root="$candidate"; break; fi; done; fi; if [ -z "$root" ] || [ ! -f "$root/scripts/bootstrap.mjs" ]; then printf 'brain: could not locate brain plugin root; install or rebuild the plugin first\n' >&2; exit 1; fi; exec node "$root/scripts/bootstrap.mjs" mcp
